variants.seed_text: The Portuguese Football Federation (FPF) has unveiled a new logo and brand identity, launched on 1 July 2026 and already live across the federation's digital platforms. variants.label: Anthropic: invisible watermarks in text generated by Claude (2026-08-11)
variants.seed_text: Anthropic announced that it is embedding invisible, machine-readable watermarks in text generated by its Claude models, as part of complying with Article 50 of the EU AI Act, whose transparency obligations took effect on August 2, 2026. Models launched from August 2 onward carry the watermark from day one, and older models are being brought in during the transition period.
